The trees `CTMLAPI` has run, under the names they were run as: the file name for one off disk, and whatever name was given for markup written in java.

Registration order is the order the scripts ran in, which is the order the ui folder listed them. A tree in here is not showing: it is a tree, waiting for a screen or a hud to be built around it.

```java
import net.tutla.craftytml.client.render.UIRegistry;
```
